name: dftracer_isolation
description: Verify a reproduction package runs in isolation (fresh copy, env -i bash -l, config.ini only) with session_verify_isolation static/launch/status; validator dftracer_isolation_check (static lint clean, launched outside the session, finished, exit 0). Load before handing a package on, or on hardcoded workspace/home paths or flux job ids in scripts, 'does not source lib_load_config.sh', 'required key ... missing', 'references missing ...sh', or an isolated run that exits non-zero.
